key_nodes.why: +1 max rare monster mods; each mod >=100% rarity

key_nodes.why: 3% more waystone explicit effect per tablet

key_nodes.name: Swamp Mastery
key_nodes.why: choice: 25% Chaos drop as Exalted (or pack size)

tablets: 3x same-mechanic tablet or generic tablets with Collector's (rarity), Brimming (rares), Breeding (pack size), Abounding (monster rarity)
strategies.waystone_setup: Rare, 6 mods (Alchemy + Exalts), instilled Liquid Paranoia/Greed, avoid the deadly list; masters: Doryani Evolutionary Pressure + Improved Calibration, Hilda Breeding Season + Ancient Inscriptions.
strategies.source: node picks: Claude from 0.5.5 node texts; direction: Boostmatch 0.5.0 guide (2026-05-28, used 0.4 names), Timesaver atlas guide (2026-08-09)

strategies.name: Breach

key_nodes.name: Shape the Chains
key_nodes.why: choice: Grow Quantity = Breaches +15% pack size

key_nodes.name: Moment of Risk
key_nodes.why: 2 extra rares when stabilised; wombgift level-up per map mod

key_nodes.name: Reactive Hiveseeding
key_nodes.why: 10% chance to add a Hive nearby

key_nodes.name: Tear Open the Rift
key_nodes.why: choice: Breach stronghold adds map mods

tablets: Breach Tablet: of the Horde (5-15% pack size), of the Form (wombgift qty 30-60%), of the Flesh (wombgift level), of the Invasion (+1-2 rares), of the Commander (Vruun)
strategies.waystone_setup: Pack-size + monster-rarity mods; 2-3 Breach tablets; 0.5.5 tier list puts Breach in B tier (3-7 div/h).
strategies.source: node texts: game data 0.5.5; tier: Timesaver 0.5.4 tier list (2026-06-28/08-07)

strategies.name: Ritual

key_nodes.name: Reborn in Shadow
key_nodes.why: revived monsters more often magic/rare = more tribute

key_nodes.name: Mysterious Rites
key_nodes.why: 8% Queen's Ritual: +10 omens in first favour set

key_nodes.name: Spreading Darkness
key_nodes.why: unique item slot type by ritual type

key_nodes.name: Hour of the Nameless
key_nodes.why: Rite of the Nameless can offer valuable uniques

tablets: Ritual Tablet: of Sacrifice (18-30% tribute), of Omens (35-70% omen chance), of Prayers (+1-3 rerolls), of the Dogma/Occult/Devotion/Appeal (cheaper/free rerolls & defers). 0.5.5: >1 Ritual tablet adds an extra altar.
strategies.waystone_setup: Pack size and magic/rare monster mods (more tribute); item rarity does not affect favours. A-tier in 0.5.4 (4-12 div/h, omen-driven).
strategies.source: node texts: game data; tribute logic: AOEAH 0.5 Ritual guide (2026-06-01, several node names wrong); tier: Timesaver 0.5.4

strategies.name: Delirium

key_nodes.name: Is that the best you've got?!
Come on! Face me!
key_nodes.why: more unique boss shards; kills pause timer

key_nodes.name: These demons are all your own...
Is this about me... or you?
Recurring Nightmares
key_nodes.why: choice: +30% deliriousness or fog spreads to +4 maps

tablets: Delirium Tablet: of Mirrors, of Shattering, of Phobia (unique bosses), of the Simulacrum (splinter stack), of Persecution (pack size), of Eternity/of the Unending (longer fog), of Freeze Time
strategies.waystone_setup: High-rarity rares; build must handle deliriousness. C-tier/spiky (3-9 div/h) in 0.5.4; highest ceiling, build-gated.
strategies.source: node texts: game data; tier: Timesaver 0.5.4

strategies.name: Expedition / Grand Expedition

key_nodes.name: Calculated Investment
key_nodes.why: choice: 1% item quantity per runic modifier

key_nodes.name: The Quest Continues
key_nodes.why: Grand Expeditions up to 3 mods, +1 area level

tablets: Expedition Tablet: of Runes (more runic markers), of Knowledge (logbooks), of Power (rarity), of Twins, of Remnants, of Ancient Evil, of Verisium, of Treasure (buried strongboxes)
strategies.waystone_setup: Any layout; rarity/monster-rarity mods. S-tier in 0.5.4 (10-20 div/h claimed; 50 = optimized ceiling). Subtree points from Grand Expedition bosses (0.5.4). Hilda Scarred Lands, Jado Eastern Knowledge.
strategies.source: node texts: game data; tier & points: Timesaver 0.5.4, PCGamesN/allthings 0.5.4 notes coverage

strategies.name: Abyss

key_nodes.name: Lord of the Pit
key_nodes.why: choice: scatter pits / effectiveness per pit / extra abyss

tablets: Abyss Tablet (0.5.0: only enables Abyss): of Hollows (+1 abyss), of Schisms (20-40% chance +4), of Treasures (pits twice as likely rewards), of the Horde, of Champions (+2-3 rares), of Dark Power, of Ossification (desecrated currency)
strategies.waystone_setup: Desecrated Abyssal prefixes (e.g. Abysses lead to Depths / overrun) if available; keep revives. A-tier (4-10 div/h) in 0.5.4; most consistent floor in 0.5.3.
strategies.source: node texts: game data; AOEAH Abyss guide (2026-06-03, unverified claims); Timesaver 0.5.3/0.5.4

key_nodes.why: extra essence chance per map mod

search_box.max_len_note: Official 0.5.0 patch notes: "Search textbox maximum length increased to 250 characters" (was 50; several mid-2026 guides still say 50). Verify in client.

syntax.terms: space-separated terms must all match (AND); a quoted string is one term and may contain spaces
syntax.negation: a leading ! excludes items matching that term (e.g. "!term" or "!a|b" excludes either)
syntax.alternation: | inside a term = OR; parentheses group alternatives
syntax.regex: regular expressions are supported inside a term: . .+ * [a-z] [0-9] \ escape, ^ $ anchors (anchor support assumed from PoE 1)
syntax.matched_text: since 0.5.0 searching by item text matches the ADVANCED description format (the Ctrl+Alt+C text), which includes affix names/tiers; patterns written against the plain text may need adjusting

quirks: quotes, spaces and ! count toward the 250 characters
numbers are text: ranges must be built from digit classes (e.g. a 2-digit value 40-99 needs [4-9]. )
short fragments can hit other mods: test each fragment against the full waystone mod list (the generator should check uniqueness)
the same search box exists in stash and vendor windows; the Atlas screen has its own live search (names, biomes, bosses, content words)
property lines (e.g. revives available, monster pack size, item rarity totals) can be matched on 0.4-era waystones; confirm the 0.5 line names from a copied waystone before relying on them
common_patterns_described: avoid-list: one negated alternation of short unique fragments of the deadly mod texts (Exposure, Smothering/Recovery Rate, Penetrates, crit chance)
want-list: positive fragments for pack size / rarity / rare monsters, or value thresholds on the summary lines
six-mod finder: match "revives available: 0" style lines (forum guide, 2025-09/2026-01)
search_box.licence_note: poe.re / poe2.re are AGPL-3.0: describe syntax only, never copy their patterns or code.

v1_watchlist.item: 1.0 launches Dec 11 PST; full patch notes about a week before (~Dec 4). Re-export the atlas tree, waystone and tablet mods then.
Conquerors of Wraeclast league: castles, factions, "delegate Atlas progression to your own commanders" (real-time endgame system); hunting-ground maps around a castle reset when it changes hands.
v1_watchlist.source: GGG Steam announcement; Maxroll ExileCon recap (2026-11-09)

v1_watchlist.item: "No plans for major difficulty increase in the endgame for 1.0"; Mark Roberts likes fewer deaths per area and more waystone modifiers (current revive/mod system likely stays).
Multichoice nodes still exist on the Atlas Passive Skill Tree in 1.0; questline locations teleportable once unlocked; league mechanics keep fixed Atlas locations; mechanic unlocks slowed.
Champion Rares (campaign) "might be added to the endgame"; Trial of the Ancestors and Sekhemas rework come after 1.0.
Rogers: late endgame was "getting stale" (same builds, jewel sockets); passive tree rework moves sockets into clusters. No statement found on waystone/tablet mod changes.
Things to re-check on 1.0 data: waystone mod list + reward values, tablet types (new league tablet?), Atlas tree node ids/positions, master keystones, search box limit.
